name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but behind a camera lens. While pursuing a degree in marketing at the University of Zagreb, he freelanced as a motorsport photographer, capturing the raw energy of local rally events. This ignited a passion that led him to seek opportunities beyond photography. After graduating, he interned with a small racing team, quickly proving his knack for innovative marketing campaigns. 

Marko's pragmatic approach stems from a deep understanding of limited resources. He's adept at crafting targeted campaigns that maximize impact without breaking the bank. His time covering lower-tier motorsport taught him valuable lessons in extracting value from modest budgets, which is a skill he now applies to Cadillac Racing. He's known for his dedication and commitment to delivering measurable results, consistently pushing boundaries to elevate the team's brand presence. 

What sets Marko apart is his unique blend of creative flair and analytical rigor. He's not afraid to experiment with unconventional marketing strategies but always grounds his ideas in data-driven insights. This allows him to develop campaigns that are both visually compelling and strategically sound, ensuring Cadillac Racing remains a dominant force both on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a side part.
physical.description: Marko is of average height with a lean build, reflecting his active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down campaign ideas, regardless of the situation.
Has a habit of meticulously organizing his desk before starting any new project.
Insists on brewing his own strong coffee every morning.
